title: Can A Plumbing Leak Ruin Your Home? – Pro2Pro (This Old House)
summary: This short This Old House segment, sponsored by HomeServe, presents a field anecdote about plumbing emergencies to illustrate how a frozen pipe and ensuing leak can escalate into significant home damage. The speaker recounts a call to a house with water frozen on the front stairs, describes the process of gaining entry under cold conditions with manual tools, and ends with a striking hazard story about a cast-iron radiator shard traveling a long distance and embedding in a wall. The minimal narrative focuses on real-world risks, practical on-site actions, and the importance of prompt professional response in avoiding or mitigating major damage from leaks.
topics: ice removal with pick and shovel
on-site safety awareness during plumbing emergencies
